name: Lost in Battle

angles.text: Mankrik's plea shows the danger Horde settlers and patrols face from Bristleback quilboar while traveling through the Barrens.
Mankrik fought fiercely in an orcish battle-rage to defend his mate, but the quilboar swarm overwhelmed him.
The ambush happened at a small tauren camp. A wandering tauren druid tended Mankrik's wounds along the Gold Road and saved his life.
A tauren druid passing along the Gold Road found Mankrik as he collapsed. The druid tended his severe wounds and kept him alive.

faq.answer: Mankrik is an orc warrior recovering at the Crossroads in the Barrens. Quilboar separated him from his wife, and he asks travelers to search the scrublands for any sign of her.

Mankrik and his wife were fighting together at a small tauren camp when Bristleback quilboar ambushed them. She held off three attackers alone before fresh reinforcements overwhelmed her and separated her from Mankrik.
faq.q: What happened to Mankrik's wife during the battle?

faq.answer: A wandering tauren druid found Mankrik on the Gold Road after the quilboar overwhelmed him. The druid tended his life-threatening wounds and saved him.
faq.q: How did Mankrik survive the quilboar ambush?

faq.answer: Bristleback quilboar swarmed a small tauren camp and attacked Mankrik and his wife. Their numbers overcame them despite their fierce resistance.
faq.q: Who attacked Mankrik and his wife?

aliases: where do i look for her
where to search for mankriks wife
faq.answer: Mankrik was found on the Gold Road after falling near a small tauren camp overrun by Bristlebacks. Travelers can search the quilboar-infested areas across the Barrens for his wife.
faq.q: Where should travelers look for Mankrik's wife?

faq.answer: Mankrik is recovering at the Crossroads in the Barrens. He waits for news or any sign of his missing wife.
faq.q: Where can Mankrik be found now?

sections.body: Mankrik, an orc warrior at the Crossroads, fought beside his wife at a small tauren camp. Bristleback quilboar suddenly swarmed them. His wife held off three attackers alone, but fresh reinforcements cut her off from Mankrik in the fight.
sections.title: Ambush at the Camp

sections.body: Mankrik faced the advancing quilboar in a blind rage, but their numbers soon brought him down. A passing tauren druid found him near death on the Gold Road and tended his wounds. Still too injured to search for his wife, Mankrik asks travelers passing through the Crossroads to look across the Barrens and bring back any sign of her.
sections.title: A Desperate Search

summary: At the Crossroads, Mankrik searches for his wife, lost in a Bristleback ambush at a tauren camp. Wounded and unable to look for her himself, he asks travelers to search the Barrens for any sign of her.
attribution: In-game quest text: Lost in Battle
